basic_details.job_title: 136 Infantry Battalion Territorial Army Recruitment Rally 2026 - 62 Soldier GD & Tradesmen Posts
basic_details.short_information: 136 Infantry Battalion (Territorial Army) Ecological, Mahar has announced a Recruitment Rally 2026 for Ex-Servicemen from the Armed Forces and Ex-Women Employees of the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change (MoEF & CC) and State Forest Departments. A total of 62 vacancies are available for Soldier General Duty and Tradesmen posts on an All India basis.

qualification.details: Candidate should be an Ex-Serviceman and Pension Holder from the Armed Forces. Ex-Servicemen from all over India are eligible to attend the recruitment rally. Candidate should be in Medical Category SHAPE-I. Character should be Exemplary / Very Good. Candidate should not be involved in any civil or criminal case. | Applicant should be a former woman employee of the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change (MoEF & CC) or State Forest Department. She should have completed a minimum of 20 years of service in MoEF & CC / State Forest Department. Eligible candidates may attend the recruitment rally as per the conditions mentioned in the recruitment notice.

selection_process: Ex-Servicemen attending the 136 Infantry Battalion Territorial Army Recruitment Rally will have to undergo the following stages:
Initial Document Check 1 Mile Run 9 Feet Ditch Pull Ups Balance Beam Interview by Board of Officers (BOO) Medical Examination
Initial Document Check Interview by Board of Officers (BOO) Proficiency Test in Afforestation and Nursery-related Activities Medical Examination
important_instructions: Mobile phones are not permitted during the recruitment rally. Candidates must report at the prescribed venue, date and time. The recruiting authority will not be responsible for accidents or injuries sustained during the rally. Army recruitment is free and fair. Candidates should not pay bribes or deal with touts. Candidature may be cancelled if a candidate is found paying a bribe, and legal action may also be initiated. Overwriting or tampering with documents/certificates is not acceptable. Fake documents or false information may result in cancellation of candidature and legal action. Candidates who do not report at the venue on the prescribed dates and time will not be allowed to participate.

content_sections.heading: What is 136 Infantry Battalion Territorial Army Recruitment Rally 2026?
content_sections.text: The 136 Infantry Battalion (Territorial Army) Ecological, Mahar Recruitment Rally 2026 is being conducted for enrolment of eligible Ex-Servicemen and eligible former women employees of MoEF & CC and State Forest Departments. Candidates who fulfil the prescribed service, medical, character and physical conditions can attend the recruitment rally directly at Kamptee, Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: 136 Infantry Battalion TA Rally Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidate should be an Ex-Serviceman and Pension Holder from the Armed Forces. Ex-Servicemen from all over India are eligible to attend the recruitment rally. Candidate should be in Medical Category SHAPE-I. Character should be Exemplary / Very Good. Candidate should not be involved in any civil or criminal case. Applicant should be a former woman employee of the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change (MoEF & CC) or State Forest Department. She should have completed a minimum of 20 years of service in MoEF & CC / State Forest Department. Eligible candidates may attend the recruitment rally as per the conditions mentioned in the recruitment notice.

content_sections.heading: 136 Infantry Battalion TA Rally Age and Service Conditions
content_sections.text: No minimum age limit has been specified for eligible Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Women Employees. Candidates should get enrolled within five years from the date of discharge/retirement as on the date of recruitment. Ex-Servicemen belonging to Other Ranks will be enrolled as Sepoy and can serve up to 50 years of age.

content_sections.heading: 136 Infantry Battalion TA Recruitment Rally Schedule 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should report at the rally venue from 05:00 AM as per the recruitment schedule.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process for Ex-Servicemen
content_sections.text: Ex-Servicemen attending the 136 Infantry Battalion Territorial Army Recruitment Rally will have to undergo the following stages: Initial Document Check 1 Mile Run 9 Feet Ditch Pull Ups Balance Beam Interview by Board of Officers (BOO) Medical Examination

content_sections.heading: Selection Process for Ex-Women Employees of MoEF & CC / State Forest Department
content_sections.text: Initial Document Check Interview by Board of Officers (BOO) Proficiency Test in Afforestation and Nursery-related Activities Medical Examination

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for 136 Infantry Battalion TA Rally 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should carry the required original documents and self-attested copies where applicable while attending the rally. Pension Payment Order (PPO) - Original Discharge Book - Original and Self-Attested Copy Domicile Certificate - Original and Self-Attested Copy Ex-Servicemen Identity Card Aadhaar Card - Original and Self-Attested Copy Recent Colour Passport Size Photographs - 10 Copies Educational Certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Attend 136 Infantry Battalion Territorial Army Recruitment Rally 2026?
content_sections.text: Check the eligibility conditions mentioned in the recruitment notice. Keep all required original documents and self-attested photocopies ready. Carry 10 recent colour passport-size photographs. Eligible candidates should report directly at Guards Regimental Centre, Garuda Dwar, Kamptee, Nagpur. Report at the venue from 05:00 AM for the recruitment rally. Attend the prescribed document check, physical test, interview, proficiency test and medical examination as applicable. There is no online application process mentioned in the recruitment notice. Eligible candidates are required to report directly at the rally venue with the prescribed documents. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="1"}

content_sections.heading: 136 Infantry Battalion TA Terms of Engagement 2026
content_sections.text: Enrolment will be purely on merit and availability of vacancies. Service rendered in Eco TA is non-pensionable. Initial enrolment will be for two years. Based on performance, engagement may be extended by one year. Ex-Servicemen belonging to Other Ranks will be enrolled as Sepoy. They can serve up to 50 years of age. Once enrolled, candidates will be liable to serve anywhere in India. An enrolled individual may be discharged if found undesirable or unsuitable. The previous pension being drawn by an Ex-Serviceman will remain untouched.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for 136 TA Eco Mahar Rally 2026
content_sections.text: Mobile phones are not permitted during the recruitment rally. Candidates must report at the prescribed venue, date and time. The recruiting authority will not be responsible for accidents or injuries sustained during the rally. Army recruitment is free and fair. Candidates should not pay bribes or deal with touts. Candidature may be cancelled if a candidate is found paying a bribe, and legal action may also be initiated. Overwriting or tampering with documents/certificates is not acceptable. Fake documents or false information may result in cancellation of candidature and legal action. Candidates who do not report at the venue on the prescribed dates and time will not be allowed to participate.

faq.question: Q1. What is 136 Infantry Battalion Territorial Army Recruitment Rally 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment rally conducted by 136 Infantry Battalion (Territorial Army) Ecological, Mahar for eligible Ex-Servicemen and eligible Ex-Women Employees of MoEF & CC / State Forest Departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in 136 Infantry Battalion TA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 62 vacancies are available, including 53 Soldier General Duty posts and 9 Tradesmen posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the vacancy details for 136 TA Eco Mahar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 53 Soldier (GD), 7 Soldier Clerk (GD), 1 Housekeeper and 1 Washerman vacancy.

faq.question: Q4. When will the 136 Infantry Battalion TA Recruitment Rally 2026 be held?
faq.answer: The recruitment rally will be conducted from 23 November to 25 November 2026. Physical tests are scheduled for 23 and 24 November, while medical examination and documentation will take place on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the 136 Infantry Battalion TA Rally 2026 be conducted?
faq.answer: The rally will be conducted at Guards Regimental Centre, Garuda Dwar, Kamptee, Nagpur.

faq.question: Q6. Who can attend the 136 Infantry Battalion Territorial Army Recruitment Rally?
faq.answer: Eligible Ex-Servicemen who are pension holders from the Armed Forces and eligible Ex-Women Employees with at least 20 years of service in MoEF & CC or State Forest Departments can attend the rally.

faq.question: Q7. What is the physical standard for Ex-Servicemen in the 136 TA Rally?
faq.answer: Ex-Servicemen should generally have a minimum height of 160 cm, minimum weight of 50 kg and chest measurement of 82 cm with at least 5 cm expansion. The height requirement is 152 cm for Gorkha, Garhwali and Assamese candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the 136 Infantry Battalion TA Rally?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry their original PPO, Discharge Book, Domicile Certificate, Ex-Servicemen Identity Card, Aadhaar Card, educational certificates, required self-attested copies and 10 recent colour passport-size photographs.
